page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable blocks of markdown. Attach one to an agent and it is injected into that agent’s review prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The skill’s interface — write it as a directive, so an agent can tell from this line alone when the rule applies.
config.bodyCaption: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata.
config.snapshotHint: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}
config.dangerBody: Removes it from all agents. This can’t be undone.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It will be unlinked from every agent.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

stats.noAgents: No agent uses this skill yet.
stats.noFindings: No run has carried this skill yet.
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body, so a past run stays readable against the exact text it used.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This saves it as a new version on top.
versions.label: v{version}

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A named block of markdown an agent can be given.
